issues.detail: The Greek text includes 'λαλειν' (speaking/talking) as a state he gained, but the Vietnamese translation 'vừa nói vừa thấy được' (could speak and see) treats 'speaking' as a simultaneous action with seeing, rather than a result of healing. More importantly, the Greek 'ωστε τον ... λαλειν και βλεπειν' implies he was made to *be able* to speak and see; the Vietnamese structure is slightly less precise regarding the transition from inability to ability.
